title: Spatial Eye + Dandelion Controls · v0.6.0
changes: Camera test, XR readiness, new item and upload now bloom around the landing mascot after a one-second pause; no separate footer action strip.
Original procedural WebAudio chimes respond to arrival (when browser audio is unlocked), XR entry, capture, extraction, grabs, selection and success. No third-party audio assets.

The central animated iris is the immersive capture control. If no camera stream is live, the first press requests Quest camera permission; a small live-preview card shows the actual feed and a second press saves real pixels. Unavailable camera access is reported clearly without generating fake frames.

A single borderless XR navigation pill sits below eye level. Drag its upper header to reposition while following, or pin it at its current world position. Selected-card actions replace, rather than duplicate, the main tools.
Image cards are sized from actual source aspect ratios and draw the whole image without cropping. A saving photo remains in the world during the transition to a persisted capture.
IMPROVE routes to an image-edit prompt and adds a generated child card; the source image is not replaced. Applying the prompt is an explicit paid action.
Quest controllers receive subtle haptic pulses on hover and grab when available. Pinch and controller trigger/grip manipulation remain supported.
No new provider accounts, billing caps or external sound files. Database schema and deployment watcher remain unchanged.
